reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is providing web_search through Tavily, including optional API-key configuration and replacement of the built-in search tool.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Tavily 的 web_search 搜索工具，并支持可选的 TAVILY_API_KEY 配置。
summaries.en: Provides a Tavily-backed web_search tool for DeepSeek Harness with optional TAVILY_API_KEY configuration.

capabilities: Performs web searches through a replacement web_search tool
Connects to the Tavily search service
Accepts an optional TAVILY_API_KEY configuration value
